page.layout: One printed page: running head with page number at top left and "ANNUS MDXXIV" heading; a list of numbered theses (8, 9, 10) in italic set indented; then running text in one column; a catchword-like marginal word "Vrstisius" in the left margin beside the paragraph starting "BASILEAE". No notes below the text.

main_text.p: 8. De bonis operibus, quòd sint meritoria vitæ æternæ, & quòd sit meritum congrui, digni, & condigni, ex lacunis scholasticorum.
9. De votis monasticis, quòd sint alter Baptismus, in quo de novo regeneretur homo, unde & nova nomina, velut in baptismo fieri solet, monachis & monialibus imponantur.
10. De Ecclesiasticis: quòd jure divino non teneantur tributum & vectigalia solvere: nec à Magistratu politico possint capi, aut carceribus includi.
Hæc omnia retractat, & ex verbo Dei convellit, nihil veritus voculas malevolorum & calumniatorum. Præfatio scripta est Bernæ Helvetiorum vr. Septembris huius anni.

Vrstisius.BASILEAE Joannes Oecolampadius magno zelo, nec minore fructu in propagando Christi regno laborat, quem frustra Joannes Cochlæus, missis Stutgardiâ literis, amplissimis promissis à veritate agnita avocare conatur. Adiungunt se Oecolampadio M. V Volfgāgus V Veissenburgius, Marcus Bersius, Frater Joannes Luthardus, Frater Thomas Geiers falck, primi reformatæ doctrinæ apud Basilienses præcones. Hoc ægerrimè ferebant sacrificuli, ideoque detonabant in ipsos diris & maledictis, hæreticorum pessimorum pœnas eos commeritos esse clamitantes. page.notes: The text of the running head is "ANNUS MDXXIV" in small capitals; the numeral is read as printed. Line "ut loquia Dei" is uncertain at "loquia" [?]. Some letters in the list headings are damaged; "Geiers falck" is printed with a space as shown. Catchword absent; the last line ends with a hyphenated word "homi-" continuing onto the next page.
